paragraphs: Rabbi Yudan ben Tarfon: [Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, chapter 1, halakhah 10](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sheviit.1.6.3).
Rabbi Levi son of Rabbi Tarfon: [Eichah Rabbah 1:33](https://www.sefaria.org/Eikhah_Rabbah.1.33). Shimon ben Tarfon: [Shevuot 47b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.47b.3-6).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sheviit passage is 1:6:3. It reads “Rabbi Yudan, according to Rabbi Trifan” (כרבי טריפן). Hyman gives Yudan ben Tarfon and cites 1:10. [Heilprin’s Yudan heading](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1737&lang=en) also reads ben Tarfon. The linked Eichah Rabbah gives Rabbi Levi be-Rabbi Tarfon, cited by [Heilprin’s Levi entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2347&lang=en). The linked Shevuot baraitot name Shimon ben Tarfon, also named under [Heilprin’s Shimon heading](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3438&lang=en).
